title: Adaptive layout contract
description: The app's adaptive-layout facts for check-adaptive-layout.mjs (adaptive-layout skill). Paths are repo-relative.

appOrientation.description: The orientation app.config sets. Default: 'default' or 'portrait' (phones only; tablets rotate anyway). 'landscape' only when the app means it.

tablets.description: false only for an app that deliberately ships no iPad layout (it then runs as a scaled phone app on iPad); needs tabletsReason.

listDetailScreens.description: Screens that show a list and its selected item: each renders ListDetailLayout.

fullBleedScreens.description: Screens whose content fills the window on purpose (a canvas, a map, a camera, media): no readable-width cap.

orientationLocks.description: Files that may lock the orientation for one screen (camera capture, a full-screen video), each with its reason.

breakpointModules.description: Globs of the files that may hold width breakpoints. Default: the window-class hook and src/ui/adaptive/**.

screenGlobs.description: Globs of the screen files the readable-width rule reads. Default: src/features/**/*-screen.tsx.

layoutGlobs.description: Globs of the UI code the layout rules read (device-branch, device-orientation, raw-breakpoint, fixed-width, readable-width-token, grid-*). Default: the routes folder, src/features/**, src/ui/**, src/hooks/**, src/theme/**. Services, core, data and api code lays nothing out.

readableComponents.description: Components that cap a screen's reading width for it. Default: ScreenFrame, ListDetailLayout.

maxFixedWidth.description: The widest fixed width a style may set (default 288: the 320 pt window minus two 16 pt gutters).
